user.title: Add SceneTV Android TV Bridge
user.description: Enter the local SceneTV bridge address.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Start pairing with this SceneTV launcher?

pair.title: Approve pairing
pair.description: Approve the pairing prompt on the TV, then submit this form.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the launcher.
error.pairing_pending: Pairing is still pending approval on the TV.

abort.already_configured: This SceneTV launcher is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the launcher.
abort.pairing_rejected: Pairing was rejected on the TV.

show_camera.name: Show camera popup
show_camera.description: Show a snapshot popup from a camera configured on SceneTV. Requires a launcher that advertises show_camera.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when only one launcher is configured.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: SceneTV device to target. Optional when only one launcher is configured.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Camera id configured in SceneTV camera settings. Stream URLs and credentials stay on the TV.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional popup title. Defaults to the camera name on the TV.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where the popup appears on screen.

duration_ms.name: Duration
duration_ms.description: How long the popup stays visible, in milliseconds (1000 to 120000).

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Take remote focus so OK or Back dismisses the popup.

profiles.name: Profiles
profiles.description: SceneTV profile ids or names that may see this popup. Overrides the camera's popup profiles on the TV.

pause_media.name: Pause media
pause_media.description: Override whether SceneTV pauses playing media while the popup is shown.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.
